nodes.source: "As I feel fine and could walk out of here now, what if I didn't want any treatment whatsoever?"
nodes.text: «Dato che mi sento bene e potrei uscire subito, che cosa succederebbe se non volessi alcuna cura?»

nodes.source: "You'd have less than a year to live"
nodes.text: «Ti resterebbe meno di un anno di vita».

nodes.source: So that really kicks the facts home I guess, Chemotherapy treatment or die, a simple one to work out!!! So, whatever it takes, however long, and whatever side effects I have to put up with, they pale into insignificance compared to the alternative.
nodes.text: Questo chiarisce tutto: chemio o morire. Facile scegliere! Qualunque cosa serva, per quanto tempo e con qualunque effetto collaterale, tutto impallidisce rispetto all’alternativa.

nodes.source: A room was allocated to me and I decided to stay in hospital to try and keep the room as my Chemotherapy treatment would start the following week. Although the consultant was happy for me to retire home until the following week, I felt more comfortable being in this environment, considering the news I was still trying to take in and believe.
nodes.text: Mi hanno assegnato una stanza e ho deciso di restare per cercare di mantenerla, dato che la chemio sarebbe iniziata la settimana successiva. Lo specialista mi avrebbe lasciato tornare a casa, ma lì mi sentivo più al sicuro mentre cercavo di assimilare e credere alle notizie.

nodes.source: 11th December 2004 - Saturday
nodes.text: 11 dicembre 2004 - sabato

nodes.source: I had to return home to refill my Mum's Parkinson's medication schedule to cover her whilst I was in hospital. Leaving the hospital was all cleared with the powers that be, so I had a shower and a good freshen up and left for Hounslow in order to be back to Hospital for dinner at 6pm. Being out of Hospital after the news I had been given was a weird experience, almost like I shouldn't be out of my comfort zone in case anything was to happen to me, so I felt a little anxious to say the least. Although sorting my Mum out was a priority, I now also had my own welfare to be concerned about.
nodes.text: Sono dovuto tornare a casa a preparare i farmaci per il Parkinson di mia madre durante il mio ricovero. Avuto il permesso, mi sono lavato e sistemato e sono partito per Hounslow, per rientrare a cena alle 18. Uscire dopo quelle notizie era strano, quasi non dovessi lasciare il luogo sicuro nel caso mi succedesse qualcosa. Ero piuttosto ansioso. Occuparmi di mamma era prioritario, ma ora dovevo pensare anche alla mia salute.

nodes.source: Upon returning to hospital at 6pm I discovered that dinner was served at 5pm so my best friend Ken Clark who, so far, has been through this whole daunting experience with me, popped over to Pizza Express which I can see from my window, to pick up some dinner.
nodes.text: Rientrato alle 18 ho scoperto che la cena era alle 17. Il mio migliore amico Ken Clark, che mi ha accompagnato in tutta questa esperienza spaventosa, è andato al Pizza Express visibile dalla finestra a prendere qualcosa.

nodes.source: 12th December 2004 - Sunday
nodes.text: 12 dicembre 2004 - domenica

nodes.source: The day passed with relative calmness although anticipation was building for my Sperm Banking, EDTA and MRI tests over the next couple of days.
nodes.text: Giornata relativamente tranquilla, ma cresceva l’attesa per la conservazione del seme e gli esami EDTA e di risonanza dei prossimi giorni.

nodes.source: 13th December 2004 - Monday
nodes.text: 13 dicembre 2004 - lunedì

nodes.source: A visit to Hammersmith Hospital over lunchtime for some Banking (I'm not going into detail here!) and discussions about how, when and who I consent to using it in the future. All consents are far from set in stone and can be changed as and when needed, but if something happened to me and I hadn't changed them, the laws surrounding consents can be very strict and would stick to the last consent I had given.
nodes.text: A pranzo sono andato all’Hammersmith Hospital per un deposito, senza dettagli! Abbiamo parlato di come, quando e a chi consentirne l’uso futuro. I consensi si possono modificare, ma se mi succedesse qualcosa senza averli cambiati, la legge è rigida e varrebbe l’ultima autorizzazione.

nodes.source: 14th December 2004 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 14 dicembre 2004 - martedì

nodes.source: Down to the 1st floor for my EDTA test at 11am which requires me to be back at 2 hour intervals, 1pm and 3pm which gave me a brief chance to get over to Hammersmith between 1pm and 3pm for another session of Banking! Increasing my future chances of having a family is a nice insurance policy to add to but on the scale of things my recovery comes first.
nodes.text: Al primo piano alle 11 per l’EDTA, tornando ogni due ore, alle 13 e alle 15. Fra questi appuntamenti sono riuscito ad andare a Hammersmith per un altro deposito. Aumentare le possibilità future di una famiglia è una bella assicurazione, ma prima viene la guarigione.

nodes.source: Back to the ward for my dinner at 5pm then a short wait for my first round of Chemotherapy, this was all explained to me in full before treatment began. Due to the lateness of its start, and the schedule of drugs they feed me intravenously, it made for a disturbing night with visits to the loo dragging a machine along with me and getting out of bed to be weighed in the early hours.
nodes.text: Tornato a cena alle 17, breve attesa per la prima chemio, spiegata in dettaglio prima di iniziare. L’inizio tardivo e la sequenza di farmaci endovenosi hanno reso la notte agitata: bagno trascinando la macchina e alzate per pesarmi all’alba.

nodes.source: 15th December 2004 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 15 dicembre 2004 - mercoledì

nodes.source: Chemotherapy didn't finish on time this morning today, so I had to break away from it to rush down for my MRI scan. I was fast asleep and luckily Ken arrived early to wake me and get me down to the 1st floor for the scan, something the nurses should have done!!
nodes.text: La chemio non è finita in tempo stamattina, così l’ho interrotta per correre alla risonanza. Dormivo profondamente; per fortuna Ken è arrivato presto, mi ha svegliato e accompagnato al primo piano. Avrebbero dovuto pensarci gli infermieri!

nodes.source: The MRI was pretty straight forward, a small injection in my arm and into the scanner I slid. I wasn't afraid; it was a little noisy and I stayed as still as possible so the resulting image would be as clear as it could be.
nodes.text: La risonanza è stata semplice: piccola iniezione al braccio e dentro l’apparecchio. Nessuna paura, un po’ di rumore, e sono rimasto fermissimo per ottenere immagini chiare.

nodes.source: Back to the ward for the final blast of Chemotherapy and then I was free for the day. After one night of Chemotherapy I didn't feel much different.
nodes.text: Tornato in reparto per l’ultima parte di chemio, poi libero per la giornata. Dopo una notte di terapia non mi sentivo molto diverso.

nodes.source: The night came quickly and I was soon connected up to the Chemotherapy drip again. They were very busy on my ward and when it came to changing my dosage bag I was left for quite some time with no through flow, this caused quite a bit of discomfort in my hand and a burning sensation.
nodes.text: La notte è arrivata presto e mi hanno ricollegato alla flebo. Il reparto era molto occupato e, al cambio della sacca, sono rimasto a lungo senza flusso, con parecchio fastidio e bruciore alla mano.

nodes.source: Another disturbing night with dosage changes, wee'ing and weighing! I did sleep better though, probably fatigued from the night before.
nodes.text: Altra notte di cambi di dose, pipì e pesate! Ho dormito meglio, forse per la stanchezza della notte prima.

nodes.source: 16th December 2004 - Thursday
nodes.text: 16 dicembre 2004 - giovedì

nodes.source: Morning came and the Chemotherapy treatment again finished a little late. Today I was to be free of any lines or taps in my hand, just another blood test, that's all.
nodes.text: Al mattino la chemio è finita ancora un po’ tardi. Oggi niente tubi o rubinetti nella mano, solo un altro prelievo.

nodes.source: Again I was feeling fine and ate everything that was put in front of me.
nodes.text: Mi sentivo ancora bene e ho mangiato tutto ciò che mi hanno messo davanti.

nodes.source: I got a look at my X-ray and MRI scans today. Thankfully the MRI was clear - still to be officially confirmed by my consultant - and the X-ray was an obvious indication that this disease was inside me and meaning business.
nodes.text: Oggi ho visto radiografia e risonanza. Per fortuna la risonanza era pulita, ancora da confermare ufficialmente dallo specialista. La radiografia mostrava chiaramente che la malattia era dentro di me e faceva sul serio.

nodes.source: The day went swiftly, although I tired towards the end, I still found the energy to set up Milton's (my ward buddy) new iMac G5, which gave him great pleasure. He's now even busier with his crusade to offer a positive approach to dealing with serious diseases like ours.
nodes.text: Giornata veloce. Pur stanco verso sera, ho trovato l’energia per configurare il nuovo iMac G5 di Milton, il mio compagno di reparto. Ne è felicissimo e ora è ancora più impegnato a promuovere un approccio positivo a malattie gravi come le nostre.

nodes.source: 17th December 2004 - Friday
nodes.text: 17 dicembre 2004 - venerdì

nodes.source: Slept well, albeit a little sweaty during the night.
nodes.text: Dormito bene, pur sudando un po’ durante la notte.

nodes.source: Today a brief chat about my test results with my consultant confirmed that the MRI test was clear, the blood test clear, the kidney test (EDTA) was good and all in order. My X-ray was alarming but the CT showed I still have plenty of lung space to breathe with comfortably and fight this disease.
nodes.text: Lo specialista ha confermato brevemente i risultati: risonanza pulita, sangue a posto, esame renale EDTA buono. La radiografia allarma, ma la TAC mostra ancora molto spazio polmonare per respirare bene e combattere la malattia.

nodes.source: Discharge day today, home for the weekend. A bit of a wait around for my medication to take home and I was off the ward and home in no time, a surreal experience since going in to A&E over a week ago!
nodes.text: Oggi dimissione per il fine settimana a casa. Un po’ d’attesa per i farmaci e via dal reparto. Un’esperienza surreale da quando sono entrato al pronto soccorso più di una settimana fa!

nodes.source: 18th December 2004 - Saturday
nodes.text: 18 dicembre 2004 - sabato

nodes.source: Slept well in my own bed last night, felt sweaty again during the night.
nodes.text: Dormito bene nel mio letto, ancora con sudori notturni.

nodes.source: Ate breakfast, ate lunch, went to see my Mum briefly then back home for dinner.
nodes.text: Colazione, pranzo, breve visita a mamma e poi a casa per cena.

nodes.source: I was asked by the doctors to monitor my temperature, matched with how I am feeling whilst at home. I didn't feel any different and my temperature was reasonable at all times (normal should be 36.5 C).
nodes.text: I medici mi hanno chiesto di controllare la temperatura insieme a come mi sentivo a casa. Nessuna differenza, valori sempre ragionevoli; la normalità dovrebbe essere 36,5 °C.

nodes.source: 19th December 2004 - Sunday
nodes.text: 19 dicembre 2004 - domenica

nodes.source: Slept a bit more awkwardly, woke up wide eyed, sweating, with a slight pain in my left lung during the night and couldn't sleep again for a bit for thinking about all that has gone on so far. Bounced myself off the walls in the dark and found the loo, back to bed and I was asleep in no time.
nodes.text: Ho dormito peggio. Mi sono svegliato con gli occhi spalancati, sudato e con un lieve dolore al polmone sinistro. Pensavo a tutto l’accaduto e non riprendevo sonno. Sbattendo contro le pareti al buio ho trovato il bagno, poi sono tornato a letto e mi sono addormentato subito.

nodes.source: This morning I'm OK, had a bit of a lie in (what's new!). The Sun is shining brightly out there today.
nodes.text: Stamattina sto bene, sono rimasto un po’ a letto, sai che novità! Oggi c’è un bel sole.

nodes.source: Relaxed all day at home, away from all the Xmas bustle outside that I keep hearing about from my friends that have phoned or visited.
nodes.text: Giornata tranquilla a casa, lontano dalla frenesia natalizia di cui parlano gli amici al telefono o in visita.

nodes.source: Back to hospital tomorrow. I'll be in for a while for my first phase of full blown BEP Chemotherapy. Getting a bit nervous.
nodes.text: Domani torno in ospedale per restare un po’, per la prima fase di chemioterapia BEP completa. Comincio a essere nervoso.

nodes.source: 20th December 2004 - Monday
nodes.text: 20 dicembre 2004 - lunedì

nodes.source: Slept really well although doing the usual sweating thing.
nodes.text: Dormito benissimo, pur con i soliti sudori.

nodes.source: It's hospital day today, not so daunting as I think the reason I'm going in today is just for NHS bed logistics, either that or 2 days away is all they are going to give me, considering the condition inside my body.
nodes.text: Oggi si torna in ospedale. Non è così spaventoso: credo sia per la gestione dei letti NHS, oppure, viste le condizioni interne, mi concedono soltanto due giorni fuori.

nodes.source: I almost don't want to go back to hospital, but know that I have no choice.
nodes.text: Quasi non vorrei tornare, ma so di non avere scelta.

nodes.source: Back at hospital now, a new Ward (6 West, F7). Nervous at first, but now settled, oh and of course they had to give me a blood test didn't they!!
nodes.text: Eccomi qui, in un nuovo reparto, 6 West, F7. Nervoso all’inizio, ora sistemato. E naturalmente un altro prelievo!

nodes.source: Big day tomorrow, as far as I know. See you then.
nodes.text: Domani è il grande giorno, che io sappia. A domani.

nodes.source: 21st December 2004 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 21 dicembre 2004 - martedì

nodes.source: Slept well although didn't go to bed until 3am as I was chilling out with Milton. This new ward I'm on doesn't even bring you breakfast, cheek!
nodes.text: Dormito bene, pur andando a letto alle tre dopo essere stato con Milton. In questo nuovo reparto neppure ti portano la colazione, che faccia tosta!

nodes.source: My 2 registrars (Dr's) came round to see me (they are under supervision by my consultant, the only one from whom I will take medical orders/instructions). They seemed pretty upbeat and happy to see me, and my initial blood results from yesterday all looked good. It seems my body is as ready as it's going to be for this Chemotherapy and they are preparing to give it to me this afternoon. They reiterated that it would be a much bigger dosage than I was given last week. Let's hope I can tough the effects out, I'm going to have a bloody good go.
nodes.text: Sono passati i due medici in formazione, supervisionati dallo specialista, l’unico da cui accetto indicazioni mediche. Sembravano ottimisti e contenti di vedermi; i primi risultati di ieri erano buoni. Il corpo sembra pronto quanto può esserlo per iniziare oggi pomeriggio. Hanno ribadito che la dose sarà molto maggiore della settimana scorsa. Spero di reggere gli effetti: ci proverò con tutte le forze.

nodes.source: Breakfast done and they are taking my blood again, although the experience is becoming easier as my new Dr's assistant/phlebotomist (blood sucker), Sylvia, is a master at taking blood and does a sterling job with me - 'the big baby' when it comes to needles.
nodes.text: Finita colazione, altro prelievo. È più facile con Sylvia, la nuova addetta ai prelievi, un’artista nel prendere sangue e trattare questo «bambinone» davanti agli aghi.

nodes.source: Another blood test this afternoon, what are these people after? My life and soul? I must admit I might be getting used to these now, either that or my mind and body has given up worrying about it so much.
nodes.text: Altro prelievo nel pomeriggio. Vogliono vita e anima? Forse mi sto abituando, oppure corpo e mente hanno smesso di preoccuparsi tanto.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy time is fast approaching and the nasty experience of having a Cannula fitted to my arm has to be overcome first.
nodes.text: Si avvicina la chemio e prima devo superare la spiacevole esperienza della cannula nel braccio.

nodes.source: Well it took them 3 goes to get the big Cannula needle in my arm; I hated this experience. Now I'm connected up and have a full 15 hours of intravenous drip Chemotherapy ahead, this will take me well into the morning tomorrow.
nodes.text: Ci sono voluti tre tentativi per infilare il grosso ago della cannula. L’ho odiato. Ora sono collegato per quindici ore di chemio endovenosa, fino a domattina inoltrata.

nodes.source: Had a few visitors tonight, been sitting in the TV room relaxing and chatting. Chemotherapy still going strong and making me wee a lot!!
nodes.text: Qualche visita, relax e chiacchiere nella sala TV. La chemio procede e mi fa fare tantissima pipì!

nodes.source: Off to bed soon, catch up with you all again tomorrow.
nodes.text: Presto a letto. Ci risentiamo domani.

nodes.source: 22nd December 2004 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 22 dicembre 2004 - mercoledì

nodes.source: Slept quite well considering 15 hours of Concorde fuel has been pumped in to me (thanks Rog). I'm awake and feeling fine, just waiting to be disconnected so I can go for yet another pee and get myself some breakfast.
nodes.text: Dormito abbastanza bene dopo quindici ore di carburante per Concorde, grazie Rog. Sveglio e in forma, aspetto che mi stacchino per altra pipì e colazione.

nodes.source: Breaking news... I'm potentially moving wards today - I pulled some strings ;) - back to South ward where I started all this. I think they miss me!! I'm 33 years and 4 months old today, exactly. Yup, it makes you think about your age too!
nodes.text: Ultim’ora: forse oggi cambio reparto, ho mosso qualche filo ;) Tornerei a South, dove è iniziato tutto. Credo che sentano la mia mancanza! Oggi ho esattamente 33 anni e quattro mesi. Sì, ti fa pensare anche all’età.

nodes.source: Getting some great inspirational emails from you all, even from people I have never met, from the furthest corners of the earth, saying it's making them go get themselves checked out. What a surprise that my site is not only being used by those of you that wish to keep up to date with me, but also by people who may benefit from my experience.
nodes.text: Arrivano email bellissime, anche da sconosciuti dagli angoli più lontani del mondo, che dicono di andare a farsi controllare. Che sorpresa: il sito serve sia per avere mie notizie sia a chi può trarre aiuto dalla mia esperienza.

nodes.source: Moved wards now, back to the original place where everyone knows me. Although I might be annoying at times, I think they like me!
nodes.text: Sono tornato nel reparto iniziale, dove tutti mi conoscono. Anche se a volte sono fastidioso, credo mi vogliano bene!

nodes.source: Back on the Chemotherapy now, another 9 hours dragging an IV machine about, but feeling fine. Hearing more and more of people's Cancer stories is quite frightening, especially people who have a similar Cancer to myself. My only consolation is that EVERYBODY IS DIFFERENT and I have to keep saying that to myself to stay positive. Good test results are a good indication too, I'm chasing after some blood test results at the moment, tell you all about it later...
nodes.text: Di nuovo chemio: nove ore trascinando la macchina, ma sto bene. Sentire tante storie di cancro spaventa, soprattutto quelle simili alla mia. Mi consola che OGNUNO È DIVERSO, me lo ripeto per restare positivo. Anche i buoni risultati aiutano. Sto rincorrendo quelli del sangue, poi vi racconto...

nodes.source: The Consultant, with both his Registrars, found me loitering on the ward. They asked if I could follow them in to a quiet room (you know the feeling I was getting now, one of anticipation and worry). Sat me down and asked all about this website, which they'll be looking at soon. Also, mentioning the results of my HCG blood test almost in passing, a test they will be taking regularly throughout my treatment cycles. The HCG markers in my blood are an indication of my Cancer and its current level. When I first came in to the Charing Cross Hospital before any treatment, the reading was 3,900. It has now lowered itself to 3,300 which suggests an improvement and my body's positive reaction to the treatment so far. Although the Consultant would have been equally happy if these figures had mildly risen, although at a slow rate. No parties yet, however much it is good news; these levels can go up as well as down.
nodes.text: Lo specialista con i due medici mi ha trovato in giro e portato in una stanza tranquilla. Immaginate l’ansia. Mi hanno fatto sedere e chiesto del sito, che visiteranno presto. Quasi di sfuggita hanno parlato dell’HCG, che misureranno regolarmente nei cicli: indica il cancro e la sua attività. All’arrivo al Charing Cross, prima delle cure, era 3900; ora è 3300, segno di miglioramento e risposta positiva. Lo specialista sarebbe stato soddisfatto anche di una crescita lieve e lenta. Niente feste ancora: buona notizia, ma i valori possono salire o scendere.

nodes.source: Originally I was told that 80 to 90 percent of the Cancer in my body should be an easy conquest, it's the last 10 percent that is the hard part to eradicate. So, all in all, so far we are heading in the right direction.
nodes.text: All’inizio mi hanno detto che eliminare l’80-90% del cancro sarebbe stato facile; è l’ultimo 10% la parte difficile. Finora andiamo nella direzione giusta.

nodes.source: Ate double dinner tonight, one hospital meal and then a takeaway Pizza from Pizza Express across the road, appetite not gone yet, in-fact it's a little more furious at times.
nodes.text: Doppia cena: pasto dell’ospedale e pizza da asporto dal Pizza Express di fronte. L’appetito non manca, a volte è persino più feroce.

nodes.source: Feeling a little more fatigued tonight, especially in the legs, possibly an indication of some Chemotherapy side effects. Still on the Chemotherapy now, should be finished by midnight and then I can get an unrestricted night's sleep.
nodes.text: Stasera più stanco, soprattutto alle gambe, forse effetto della chemio. Collegato fino a mezzanotte, poi potrò dormire libero.

nodes.source: 23rd December 2004 - Thursday
nodes.text: 23 dicembre 2004 - giovedì

nodes.source: Awoke early today at 6am to have my blood pressure checked etc. Usual routine but I awoke with a startle and nearly karate chopped (like Inspector Clueso) the nurse. I warned her to be a little kinder when waking me or her life might be on the line!
nodes.text: Mi hanno svegliato alle sei per pressione e routine. Ho sobbalzato e quasi dato un colpo di karate all’infermiera, come l’ispettore Clouseau. L’ho avvertita di svegliarmi più dolcemente o rischia la vita!

nodes.source: Got back to sleep for a bit, despite a lot of activity on my ward. Breakfast out the way now, I usually have 2 Weetabix with warm milk. Got my Christmas dinner menu today, hospital Christmas dinner whoopee! The doctors and nurses really pity you when then hear that you are in for the Xmas period, I'm so not bothered they cannot believe it. Honestly, when faced with something like this, nothing else should matter but your recovery (I was never really an Xmas person anyway, I'll save all my Xmas joy for the day when and if I'm given the chance to have my own family).
nodes.text: Ho ripreso sonno nonostante il movimento. Colazione con i soliti due Weetabix e latte caldo. Oggi è arrivato il menu natalizio: evviva il Natale in ospedale! Medici e infermieri mi compatiscono perché resto qui; non credono a quanto poco mi importi. Davanti a questo conta solo guarire. Non sono mai stato molto natalizio: conserverò la gioia per quando, se potrò, avrò una famiglia mia.

nodes.source: Third day of Chemotherapy today, another 9 hours connected to a drip machine. That should be around 2pm I guess so making the most of my unattached freedom is a must.
nodes.text: Terzo giorno di chemio, altre nove ore collegato. Credo dalle 14, quindi devo godermi la libertà.

nodes.source: Ahh, I saw the blood test trolley come round just now and yes they wanted some... I must be getting used to these now as it went OK although I still didn't look!
nodes.text: È passato il carrello dei prelievi e sì, ne volevano ancora. Mi sto abituando: tutto bene, anche se non guardo!

nodes.source: The Registrars came through to have a quick word, nothing major just a friendly 'how you feeling' and I think they can see I'm doing just fine so far.
nodes.text: I medici sono passati a chiedere amichevolmente come sto, niente di importante. Credo vedano che procede bene.

nodes.source: Lunch out the way, a quick bath, shave and dressed to impress. I'm on top form for another 9 hour round with the Chemotherapy IV machine.
nodes.text: Pranzo, bagno rapido, rasatura e vestito a puntino. In gran forma per altre nove ore con la macchina della chemio.

nodes.source: Today marks 2 weeks since I was first diagnosed with Cancer. How about that?
nodes.text: Oggi sono due settimane dalla diagnosi di cancro. Che ve ne pare?

nodes.source: I've just witnessed the inception of Milton's Xmas single which should be available on his site for download tomorrow or Xmas day. Please support him and go get yourself a copy from his site. He's a fine musician indeed.
nodes.text: Ho visto nascere il singolo natalizio di Milton, scaricabile dal suo sito domani o a Natale. Sostenetelo e procuratevene una copia. È davvero un ottimo musicista.

nodes.source: Ken went out for Kebab Kid for us all tonight (another 4th meal, appetite is still good). I've really fancied one since being here and being not so far away from my favourite kebab shop (very unlike your traditional drunken kebab shop, this has been voted one of the best in London by Time Out). Regular takeaway food is not advisable while on Chemotherapy but I would say KK passes the tests! It certainly went down fast enough with a bag of chips to follow.
nodes.text: Ken è andato al Kebab Kid per tutti: quarto pasto, l’appetito regge. Ne avevo voglia da quando sono qui, così vicino al mio preferito. Non è il solito posto da ubriachi: Time Out l’ha votato tra i migliori di Londra. Il normale cibo da asporto è sconsigliato in chemio, ma direi che KK supera l’esame! È sparito subito, seguito dalle patatine.

nodes.source: A friend  is here taking pictures of Milton and I, for our web-sites (providing his Kebab with chillies stops repeating on him!); they'll be up on the website soon.
nodes.text: Un amico fotografa Milton e me per i nostri siti, purché il kebab piccante smetta di tornargli su! Presto le foto saranno online.

nodes.source: Only a few hours of Chemotherapy to go tonight; running a bit behind and should be finished tonight by 1am. I'm sure I'll be suitably tired by then.
nodes.text: Mancano poche ore di chemio. Siamo in ritardo e finiremo all’una. Sarò abbastanza stanco, di sicuro.

nodes.source: Signing off for now... until tomorrow...
nodes.text: Per ora chiudo... A domani...

nodes.source: 24th December 2004 - Friday (Xmas Eve)
nodes.text: 24 dicembre 2004 - venerdì (vigilia di Natale)

nodes.source: Chemotherapy day 4 today, should start around 2pm'ish!
nodes.text: Quarto giorno di chemio, dovrebbe iniziare verso le 14!

nodes.source: Didn't sleep brilliantly last night, not for want of it though! Bleeps and beeps from other patients' machines kept me in a light sleep and also a few visits to the loo. I keep mentioning my visits to the loo because it's actually a good sign that my kidneys are flushing correctly and quickly, especially with all this Chemotherapy I am having, it's all fluid given by IV and if I retained it all I'd probably drown!!
nodes.text: Non ho dormito benissimo, non per mancanza di voglia. I bip delle altre macchine mi tenevano nel sonno leggero, oltre alle visite in bagno. Le cito spesso perché sono un buon segno: i reni smaltiscono bene e rapidamente tutti i liquidi della chemio endovenosa. Se li trattenessi, annegherei!

nodes.source: Breakfast all done, I had the usual. Just going to relax a bit and reply to a few more of the many supportive emails I've received from you all.
nodes.text: Solita colazione. Ora relax e risposte alle tante email di sostegno che mi avete mandato.

nodes.source: One of the nurses was humming "Here comes the Sun" by George Harrison whilst making my bed, a song close to my heart. It was like a little message to me as I've always come across it at emotional or special times in my life. I'm guessing she heard it in Milton's room earlier and now I cannot get it out of my head (I'm not really trying to either!).
nodes.text: Un’infermiera canticchiava «Here Comes the Sun» di George Harrison rifacendo il letto, una canzone che mi sta a cuore. Sembrava un messaggio: la incontro sempre nei momenti emotivi o speciali. Forse l’ha sentita nella stanza di Milton. Ora non riesco a togliermela dalla testa, e neppure ci provo!

nodes.source: I hope you enjoy the new images section (thanks Ken), I'll be adding to them frequently now, mainly throughout each phase of my Intense Chemotherapy. IF there's a change in the way I look over time, which there may well be, then I don't want you to become alarmed - it's all part of the healing process, I'm suitably informed (or at least the side effects of Chemotherapy). Mind you, for those of you that don't know me, I'm not that good looking anyway ;-) !!!
nodes.text: Spero vi piaccia la nuova sezione immagini, grazie Ken. Ne aggiungerò spesso durante le fasi di chemio intensiva. Se il mio aspetto cambia, come potrebbe, non allarmatevi: mi dicono che fa parte della guarigione, o almeno degli effetti collaterali. Per chi non mi conosce, non sono poi così bello! ;-)

nodes.source: Had a visit from my consultant and one of his registrars again. They're still happy with my progress and will be taking another blood test today! I also have to have an injection whilst at home called a G-CSF which should help me stay healthy over and above any side effects of Chemotherapy. Can you see me injecting myself, I don't think so! Any volunteers, a nice nurse perhaps?
nodes.text: Sono tornati lo specialista e un medico. Contenti dei progressi, oggi faranno un altro prelievo. A casa dovrò fare un’iniezione di G-CSF per mantenermi sano nonostante gli effetti della chemio. Mi vedete a pungermi da solo? Io no! Volontari, magari una bella infermiera?

nodes.source: I've just completed a massive update in the Links section of my site for those of you that are interested to read more detail about some of the tests and medical names I have mentioned.
nodes.text: Ho appena ampliato molto la sezione collegamenti per chi vuole approfondire esami e termini medici citati.

nodes.source: Blood test done, I'm definitely getting used to these or I have found the best nurse there is at doing them; I want to give her a hug.
nodes.text: Prelievo fatto. O mi abituo, o ho trovato l’infermiera migliore in assoluto. Vorrei abbracciarla.

nodes.source: Finally back on the Chemotherapy, it's been manic here this afternoon with patients being discharged and new patients arriving. They just haven't had time to get to me, so I had to go and beg them at the ward reception for my treatment to start. 4pm start time means I will not be free of the IV machine until just before 2am tonight, another late night!
nodes.text: Finalmente chemio. Pomeriggio caotico tra dimissioni e nuovi arrivi. Non avevano tempo per me, così sono andato a supplicare che iniziassero. Cominciare alle 16 significa restare collegato fino a quasi le due. Un’altra notte lunga!

nodes.source: Some of the patients around me are in quite a bad way, a permanent reminder that Cancer is a potential killer and not to be ignored in our lives. A vicar has visited the patient opposite me, it really opens your eyes when it comes to that.
nodes.text: Alcuni pazienti vicini stanno molto male, un richiamo costante al fatto che il cancro può uccidere e non va ignorato. Un pastore è venuto dal paziente di fronte. Quando si arriva a questo, si aprono davvero gli occhi.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy schedule gone a bit haywire tonight, I'm still waiting for my final 4 hour bag at 22.45 which means I will not finish until 3am now. Another disturbed night, I'll not be rested well for Santa. Couldn't resist a Pizza Express blow-out tonight so Ken went down to get the takeaway order for us all.
nodes.text: Orari della chemio sballati. Alle 22:45 aspetto ancora l’ultima sacca da quattro ore: finirò alle tre. Altra notte disturbata, non sarò riposato per Babbo Natale. Non ho resistito a una scorpacciata di Pizza Express; Ken è sceso a prendere l’ordine per tutti.

nodes.source: Definitely tiring for bed now and not looking forward to my noisy and delirious neighbour (a new addition to the ward), been seriously thinking about sleeping in the TV room under the Xmas tree!
nodes.text: Ho sonno e non ho voglia del nuovo vicino rumoroso e delirante. Penso seriamente di dormire sotto l’albero di Natale nella sala TV!

nodes.source: I hope that tonight Santa brings you all you wished for.
nodes.text: Spero che Babbo Natale stanotte vi porti tutto ciò che desiderate.

nodes.source: 25th December 2004 - Saturday (Xmas Day)
nodes.text: 25 dicembre 2004 - sabato (Natale)

nodes.source: Merry Christmas to all of you. I don't expect many of you will be checking in on me today with all your presents and festivities. Not so much for me, as I'm doing just fine and Xmas doesn't bother me, but please spare a thought for those who are less fortunate than yourselves today. After all, Xmas is a time of giving, so a little kind thought wouldn't do you any harm! As I haven't had much time to organise Xmas cards for you all, Ken has kindly decorated my site for your Xmas enjoyment! What a cheapskate I am, one Xmas card for you all!!!
nodes.text: Buon Natale a tutti. Fra regali e feste immagino che pochi passeranno qui oggi. Non tanto per me, che sto bene e non mi preoccupo del Natale, ma pensate a chi è meno fortunato. È tempo di donare: un pensiero gentile non fa male! Non avendo organizzato biglietti, Ken ha decorato il sito per voi. Che tirchio, un solo biglietto per tutti!

nodes.source: Well I did manage a couple of hours on the sofa in the TV room whilst my Chemotherapy drip finished which, as I suspected, finished around 3am, the bleeper alarm woke me up. This also gave ample time for some medication to take effect on the delirious and noisy man that had moved next to me in my ward. I had to ask the nurses to do something; although I did feel sorry for him, I needed my sleep time too!!
nodes.text: Ho dormito un paio d’ore sul divano mentre finiva la chemio, verso le tre come previsto; mi ha svegliato l’allarme. Intanto i farmaci hanno avuto tempo di agire sul vicino delirante e rumoroso. Ho chiesto aiuto agli infermieri: mi dispiaceva per lui, ma dovevo dormire anch’io!

nodes.source: They've moved my noisy neighbour just now and the chap on the other side is not doing so well, in-fact he's just been sick so I'm putting off my breakfast until I get up to go get it, I'm having a cup of tea for now. This morning I feel rested but I hope to get an early night again tonight.
nodes.text: Hanno spostato il vicino rumoroso. Quello dall’altro lato sta male e ha appena vomitato, così rimando la colazione finché non andrò a prenderla. Intanto tè. Mi sento riposato, ma spero di andare a letto presto stasera.

nodes.source: Waiting for my friend Ken to arrive before I open any of my presents, I expect something Xmas related will be going on in the ward today. Humbug!
nodes.text: Aspetto Ken per aprire i regali. Immagino ci sarà qualcosa di natalizio in reparto. Bah, sciocchezze!

nodes.source: Noisy neighbour is back. I'm going to have to spend the day away from my bed, not such a bad thing I guess.
nodes.text: Il vicino rumoroso è tornato. Passerò la giornata lontano dal letto, forse non è un male.

nodes.source: My consultant popped round to say hello, although not dressed in a Santa outfit... he's very happy with my progress so far!
nodes.text: Lo specialista è passato a salutare, ma senza vestito da Babbo Natale. È molto contento dei progressi!

nodes.source: Xmas lunch out the way (in-fact they brought me two by mistake, the first one wasn't mine but by the time they realised I had eaten it and then they gave me another!). Chemotherapy is due to start again soon, it looks like it'll be another late one tonight. Milton has launched his alternative Christmas Single today "That's Christmas". Produced in 2.5 days from his hospital room whilst undergoing Chemotherapy, the (alternative) Christmas Single is all about what's crap about Christmas but great about people!
nodes.text: Finito il pranzo natalizio, anzi due per errore: il primo non era mio, ma l’avevo già mangiato quando se ne sono accorti e ne hanno portato un altro. Presto riparte la chemio, altra notte lunga. Oggi Milton ha pubblicato «That’s Christmas», singolo natalizio alternativo prodotto in due giorni e mezzo dalla stanza durante la chemio: sul brutto del Natale e sul bello delle persone!

nodes.source: At last Chemotherapy has restarted at 15.50, which means approximately another 9 hours on before I'm finished tonight. The nurses bought me a gift of some shower scrub but no nurse to go along with it! The main present I really wanted for Xmas was my Chemotherapy; after all that's why I'm here, for treatment, let's get this whole thing in to focus again!
nodes.text: Finalmente iniziata alle 15:50: circa nove ore prima di finire. Gli infermieri mi hanno regalato uno scrub da doccia, ma nessuna infermiera insieme! Il regalo principale che volevo era la chemio: sono qui per curarmi. Rimettiamo a fuoco le priorità!

nodes.source: On the final 4 hour stint of my first major phase of Chemotherapy now, managed to get ahead of schedule, looks like I'll be finished by 2am. Hopefully they will have suitably calmed my neighbour so I can get to bed and get some decent shuteye.
nodes.text: Ultime quattro ore della prima fase importante. Abbiamo recuperato e finirò verso le due. Spero abbiano calmato il vicino per dormire decentemente.

nodes.source: Still eating more, I've enjoyed a Hamper full of goodies tonight that one of my friends kindly brought over for me. There's been talk of me being discharged tomorrow, we'll see what that brings, I really don't mind either way, it depends on how I feel and how a new set of blood test results look in the morning.
nodes.text: Continuo a mangiare: ho gustato un cesto pieno di prelibatezze portato da un amico. Si parla di dimissione domani. Per me va bene comunque; dipenderà da come sto e dagli esami del mattino.

nodes.source: Sleep well with all your Xmas tummies!!
nodes.text: Dormite bene con le vostre pance natalizie!

nodes.source: 26th December 2004 - Sunday (Boxing Day)
nodes.text: 26 dicembre 2004 - domenica (Boxing Day)

nodes.source: So much for the sleep, although what I did manage to get was reasonable, managed the 2am bedtime and went off to sleep almost immediately, only to be woken be the moans and screams of the man next to me at around 6.45am. I pressed my nurse call button to get him some attention but I think that there is nothing more they can do for him, he is delirious, confused, rambling and most of all sounds scared that he will be left alone to die.
nodes.text: Il sonno è durato poco, anche se buono. Addormentato subito alle due, mi sono svegliato verso le 6:45 per urla e lamenti del vicino. Ho chiamato gli infermieri, ma credo non possano fare altro. Delira, è confuso, sconnesso e soprattutto teme di essere lasciato solo a morire.

nodes.source: It may sound harsh but I cannot do anything for him apart from call the nurse, I have detached myself from the situation now and have taken up residence in the TV room to spend the rest of my early morning in the peace and quiet of my own company (and a little TV!). It hurts quite a bit when I see others suffering around me, mainly terminal in my section of the ward. I must stay positive about my own condition, so some isolation in this room by myself was my only option.
nodes.text: Sembra duro, ma posso solo chiamare l’infermiera. Mi sono distaccato e rifugiato nella sala TV per trascorrere il primo mattino in pace, con me stesso e un po’ di televisione. Fa male vedere soffrire gli altri, molti terminali nella mia zona. Per restare positivo sulla mia condizione, isolarmi un po’ era l’unica scelta.

nodes.source: It's starting to get busy now out in the corridors, it'll be breakfast time soon.
nodes.text: I corridoi si animano. Presto colazione.

nodes.source: The usual breakfast out the way and it turns out I did need some more sleep as I dozed off on the sofa in the TV room. Woke up about an hour later.
nodes.text: Dopo la solita colazione mi sono addormentato sul divano per un’ora. Evidentemente serviva altro sonno.

nodes.source: Just had a Blood Test, definitely easier to cope with but I'm still not watching! The result of which will determine both my requirement for the HCG injections and my current HCG counts.
nodes.text: Altro prelievo, più facile da sopportare, ma non guardo! Determinerà il bisogno delle iniezioni HCG e i livelli HCG attuali.

nodes.source: Lunch approaching and I'm getting hungry, methinks it'll be quite a wait today before they give me their decision on my discharge and or injection schedule.
nodes.text: Si avvicina il pranzo e ho fame. Credo che aspetterò parecchio la decisione sulla dimissione e sulle iniezioni.

nodes.source: Discharged at 15.45 without the need for an immune boost (HCG) as my blood test results have shown that I tolerated the first phase of Chemotherapy very well. My body is still able to fight off infections by itself, although possibly mildly dampened, so I have to be careful of my exposure to germs etc.
nodes.text: Dimesso alle 15:45 senza bisogno di sostegno immunitario (HCG): gli esami mostrano che ho tollerato bene la prima fase. Il corpo combatte ancora le infezioni, seppure forse un po’ indebolito, quindi attenzione ai germi.

nodes.source: So this ends phase 1 of my particular Chemotherapy regime. I'm not sure if the strength of the Chemotherapy in the following 3 major phases will be increased in strength (this entry is going to serve as a reminder to me to get this answer as soon as possible). I will need more power and strength to overcome greater doses.
nodes.text: Finisce la prima fase del mio regime. Non so se le prossime tre fasi principali avranno dosi maggiori; questo appunto mi ricorderà di chiederlo presto. Servirebbe più forza per affrontarle.

nodes.source: At the beginning of each major phase, I will be X-rayed to have some visual results as to the increase,
nodes.text: All’inizio di ogni fase principale farò una radiografia per vedere l’aumento,

nodes.source: or more positively, and what I will be hoping for the most...
nodes.text: o, più positivamente, quello che spero soprattutto...

nodes.source: the demise of the Cancer that is showing on my lungs.
nodes.text: la scomparsa del cancro nei polmoni.

nodes.source: Home for dinner and an undisturbed night's sleep.
nodes.text: A casa per cena e sonno indisturbato.

nodes.source: 27th December 2004 - Monday
nodes.text: 27 dicembre 2004 - lunedì

nodes.source: Good morning! I managed 8 hours of good sleep, I don't want to overdo the lie in as I still need to stick to a regular eating regime, so I'm about to go have my Weetabix but this time at home!
nodes.text: Buongiorno! Otto ore di buon sonno. Non voglio alzarmi tardi, devo mantenere pasti regolari. Vado a prendere i Weetabix, stavolta a casa!

nodes.source: It occurred to me last night that my consultant and doctors may be occasionally looking in on this diary, so not only is it acting as a means of communication for me and a means of awareness for others but also as a kind of Bio Monitor for my doctors, as they can just check in to see how I'm feeling!!
nodes.text: Ieri pensavo che forse i medici leggono questo diario. Oltre a comunicare e sensibilizzare, potrebbe fare da monitor biologico per vedere come sto!

nodes.source: Well this morning I feel fine, apart from a little bit of a throat (probably from snoring after my comfortable sleep) and a snotty nose, can't explain that! I'll stick to my given tablet regime 1 Allopurinol 100mg in the morning along with 2 Domperidome 10mg 3 times a day. I also have a mouth wash to keep any nasty germs at bay, although my immune system result was good and I should be able fight off infection myself, I'll try not give it too much work to do. No feeling of sickness at all.
nodes.text: Oggi bene, tranne un po’ di gola, forse dal russare nel sonno comodo, e naso che cola senza spiegazione. Seguo le compresse: un allopurinolo da 100 mg al mattino e due domperidoni da 10 mg tre volte al giorno. Anche collutorio contro i germi. Le difese sono buone e dovrebbero combattere le infezioni, ma non voglio sovraccaricarle. Nessuna nausea.

nodes.source: Wouldn't it be a good idea for temporarily discharged patients to wear a bio monitor to analyse statistics, the results of which would be available securely online to the doctors, and if anything went wildly wrong alarms would be raised etc. They put curfew monitors on prisoners these days, why not use similar technology? I'll shut up before I get carried away.
nodes.text: Non sarebbe utile un monitor biologico per pazienti dimessi temporaneamente, con dati accessibili online in sicurezza ai medici e allarmi se qualcosa non va? Mettono braccialetti di controllo ai detenuti: perché non una tecnologia simile? Taccio prima di farmi prendere troppo.

nodes.source: Been keeping myself busy all day; healthy eating and drinking very well indeed!
nodes.text: Occupato tutto il giorno, mangiando sano e bevendo molto bene.

nodes.source: Tiring now, ready for another good night's sleep!
nodes.text: Stanco, pronto per un’altra buona notte.

nodes.source: 28th December 2004 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 28 dicembre 2004 - martedì

nodes.source: Another good night's sleep, although the 3 litres of water I drank during the course of yesterday had me up a few times! I didn't wake up until 11am this morning.
nodes.text: Altra buona notte, anche se i tre litri d’acqua di ieri mi hanno fatto alzare più volte. Sveglio solo alle 11.

nodes.source: Anticipation is building for my hospital visit tomorrow. I have my Emla cream (which numbs an area of skin like a local anaesthetic) at the ready to make the Cannulation (don't look at that link if you are squeamish) experience a little easier for me.
nodes.text: Cresce l’attesa per domani. Pronta la crema Emla, che intorpidisce la pelle come anestetico locale, per facilitare la cannula. Non guardate il collegamento se siete impressionabili.

nodes.source: Busy all day again, not eaten as well as other days, not through want of trying!!
nodes.text: Altra giornata piena. Mangiato meno bene, non per mancanza di tentativi!

nodes.source: Today I have noticed a slight noise in my ears, more of a very high pitched tone than a ringing (which could be a chemo side effect), I thought I heard it yesterday but ignored it, the same happened today so I'm letting you know! Changes are afoot inside me, there's a full scale war going on and
nodes.text: Oggi sento un rumore alle orecchie, più un tono acutissimo che un ronzio, forse effetto della chemio. Sentito ieri e ignorato, oggi torna e ve lo dico. Dentro qualcosa cambia, c’è una guerra totale e

nodes.source: I AM GOING TO WIN.
nodes.text: VINCERÒ.

nodes.source: Not so sleepy tonight, may be the anticipation of tomorrow's events, plus I have to be up early in the morning, back to hospital regimes.
nodes.text: Stasera meno sonno, forse per domani. E devo alzarmi presto: tornano gli orari ospedalieri.

nodes.source: 29th December 2004 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 29 dicembre 2004 - mercoledì

nodes.source: Not much sleep last night, managed about 5 hours and awoke with a terrible cramp in the calf muscle of my right leg. I've never suffered from cramp apart from in my feet on a couple of rare occasions.
nodes.text: Dormito circa cinque ore, svegliato da un crampo terribile al polpaccio destro. Mai sofferto di crampi, salvo raramente ai piedi.

nodes.source: Got to the Hospital on time and checked in with South 6 to find out where I am to go for my outpatient treatment. Outpatient Chemotherapy is given on the same floor in the East wing of Charing Cross Hospital.
nodes.text: Arrivato puntuale, ho chiesto a South 6 dove andare. La chemio ambulatoriale è sullo stesso piano, ala East del Charing Cross.

nodes.source: Had my blood test taken, I didn't like this much today. My Chemotherapy has arrived in a special drug case and I'm due to start very soon.
nodes.text: Prelievo fatto, oggi non mi è piaciuto. La chemio è arrivata nella valigetta speciale e presto inizia.

nodes.source: I had the Emla cream applied to my right arm at the time of my blood test in readiness for the Cannulation which I am still not looking forward to.
nodes.text: Durante il prelievo hanno applicato Emla al braccio destro per la cannula, che ancora temo.

nodes.source: Briefly spoke with the doctor and he's confirmed that the dosages of Chemotherapy are to stay the same throughout my treatment, so here's hoping that I can tolerate the rest of this as well as I have so far.
nodes.text: Il medico conferma dosi uguali per tutta la terapia. Spero di tollerare il resto altrettanto bene.

nodes.source: Well what can I say, the Cannulation experience was a revelation, I didn't feel a thing. Not wanting to speak too soon, I might feel a sting when the effect wears off, but by far that must be the lesser of the two evils. The Emla cream worked a miracle and will now in future be my saviour.
nodes.text: La cannula è stata una rivelazione: non ho sentito nulla. Forse brucerà quando passa l’effetto, ma è il male minore. Emla ha fatto un miracolo e sarà la mia salvezza.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy started at 11am, that means I should be finished at 5pm tonight. They will not let me move from this ward so I am a prisoner for 6 hours! I can see me watching quite a few DVDs on the laptop over the next few months of my outpatient visits.
nodes.text: Iniziata alle 11, dovrebbe finire alle 17. Non posso lasciare il reparto, sei ore prigioniero! Prevedo tanti DVD sul portatile durante le visite dei prossimi mesi.

nodes.source: Ok I've watched Collateral with Tom Cruise on my laptop, it's over and I'm bored. Feeling a little run down like I'm catching a cold; this is to be expected I'm told.
nodes.text: Visto Collateral con Tom Cruise, ora mi annoio. Mi sento giù, come se arrivasse un raffreddore; dicono sia previsto.

nodes.source: Looking forward to going home soon and relaxing.
nodes.text: Non vedo l’ora di tornare a casa e riposare.

nodes.source: Once home, I started feeling a chill and slightly feverish. Checked my temperature and it was just within limits, a bit of cramp in my feet this time and I got myself off to sleep on the sofa for a couple of hours.
nodes.text: A casa brividi e sensazione di febbre. Temperatura appena entro i limiti, stavolta crampi ai piedi. Dormito un paio d’ore sul divano.

nodes.source: Couldn't eat my dinner tonight, just didn't feel hungry.
nodes.text: Non sono riuscito a cenare, niente fame.

nodes.source: I've woken up now and feel a little better.
nodes.text: Ora sveglio, un po’ meglio.

nodes.source: A good night's sleep is ahead.
nodes.text: Mi aspetta una buona notte di sonno.

nodes.source: 30th December 2004 - Thursday
nodes.text: 30 dicembre 2004 - giovedì

nodes.source: A solid sleep, interrupted by a few visits to the loo. I normally sleep right through, so I can only imagine this increased water works activity is due to the extra fluid I have taken on during Chemotherapy.
nodes.text: Sonno profondo, interrotto dal bagno. Di solito dormo ininterrottamente; sarà per i liquidi extra della chemio.

nodes.source: I've had a lazy morning, didn't get up until 10.30am and certainly feel a whole load better than I did last night. So far last night was the worst I have felt in a long while. No sickness, but lost my appetite completely and had a fever/chill.
nodes.text: Mattina pigra, alzato alle 10:30, sto molto meglio. Ieri sera il peggio da tempo: niente nausea, ma zero appetito e febbre con brividi.

nodes.source: Hopefully back on track today after a light breakfast and some orange juice.
nodes.text: Spero di riprendermi dopo colazione leggera e succo d’arancia.

nodes.source: I will definitely be taking it very easy today.
nodes.text: Oggi prenderò tutto con molta calma.

nodes.source: I've driven a few places in my car, mainly for shopping, the first time I've been out properly now for almost 3 weeks. I'm now rubbing my tummy ready for dinner!!
nodes.text: Sono andato in auto in vari posti, soprattutto a fare spesa: prima vera uscita in quasi tre settimane. Ora mi preparo alla cena!

nodes.source: Eaten loads tonight, all healthy I might add! Not feeling too tired but will try to get my head down soon.
nodes.text: Mangiato tantissimo stasera, tutto sano. Non molto stanco, ma proverò a dormire presto.

nodes.source: Goodnight everybody!
nodes.text: Buonanotte a tutti!

nodes.source: 31st December 2004 - Friday
nodes.text: 31 dicembre 2004 - venerdì

nodes.source: Good morning. I didn't sleep much, probably went off about 03.00 and I've woken up at 08.30, not through want of trying but I just wasn't that tired for some reason. I'll try to get a little snooze during today, but I'm not too good at daytime napping. I haven't mentioned my night time sweats for a while, but they are still ongoing, every single night, they are a better experience in my own bed over the hospital beds as they are water proofed underneath.
nodes.text: Buongiorno. Dormito poco, dalle tre alle 8:30; ci provavo, ma non avevo sonno. Tenterò un pisolino, anche se non sono bravo. I sudori continuano ogni notte, pur non avendoli citati. Nel mio letto sono più sopportabili che in quelli impermeabilizzati dell’ospedale.

nodes.source: It's not contagious, just not very attractive! Besides there isn't any girlfriend in my life at the moment so I'm not bothering anyone!! I'm hoping as I get better inside the sweats will subside; the doctor did explain that it was due to increased hormone levels due to the Cancer. Did I tell you all that if I took a pregnancy test at the moment it would show up positive? Weird; I'm so tempted to try!!
nodes.text: Non è contagioso, solo poco attraente. E non ho una ragazza, quindi non disturbo nessuno! Spero che i sudori diminuiscano migliorando. Il medico dice che sono dovuti agli ormoni elevati per il cancro. Vi ho detto che ora un test di gravidanza sarebbe positivo? Strano, sono tentato di provare!

nodes.source: Well it's the last day of a horrible year and a bit for me (see thoughts section). I hope to put it all to rest tonight and look forward to a thriving and healthy future for us all, starting tomorrow!!
nodes.text: Ultimo giorno di un anno e più orribile per me, vedi Riflessioni. Spero di lasciarlo alle spalle stanotte e guardare a un futuro prospero e sano per tutti, da domani!

nodes.source: I'm thinking of going out to celebrate the New Year tonight,
nodes.text: Penso di uscire a festeggiare Capodanno stasera,

nodes.source: strictly
nodes.text: rigorosamente

nodes.source: no alcohol but I don't see what harm one night out will do. I'm a little worried about my energy level and lungs breathing in a lot of smoke, it's why I popped in to a pub yesterday for a trial run. I just don't want to give my body too much extra work to do at the moment. Although so far I have been fine out, have plenty of energy and my breathing seems totally normal. As you can see, I am concerned about the idea, but think I will regret it if I don't go to my second home in Richmond (most of you know where I go, part of the furniture, it wouldn't be the same without me).
nodes.text: niente alcol, ma non vedo il danno di una sera fuori. Mi preoccupano energia e fumo nei polmoni; ieri ho provato entrando in un pub. Non voglio sovraccaricare il corpo. Finora ho energia e respiro normalmente. Mi preoccupa, sì, ma rimpiangerei di non andare nella mia seconda casa a Richmond. Sapete dove: faccio parte dell’arredamento, non sarebbe uguale senza di me.

nodes.source: Ate a big breakfast and a hearty lunch, now in need of a snooze.
nodes.text: Colazione e pranzo abbondanti, ora serve un pisolino.

nodes.source: A few of my 'friends' have changed their minds with regard to the tentative plans they had made with me earlier this week and I was so looking forward to having a few buddies around me tonight to see the New Year in. Now I will make other plans for tonight, I might even just go to bed!
nodes.text: Alcuni «amici» hanno cambiato i piani provvisori della settimana. Speravo di accogliere l’anno con qualche amico. Farò altri programmi, magari andrò a letto!

nodes.source: Cheers...
nodes.text: Salute...

nodes.source: Managed to get out and enjoy my New Year! Although not with my usual gang I had a good time (I was glad of the company) and was happy to act as cabby, I know from many years first hand experience what a nightmare it can be to get home on New Year's Eve. Obviously I stuck to the
nodes.text: Sono riuscito a uscire e godermi Capodanno! Senza il gruppo abituale, ma mi sono divertito, contento della compagnia e di fare da tassista. So per esperienza quanto sia difficile tornare a casa a Capodanno. Naturalmente ho seguito il regime

nodes.source: strictly
nodes.text: rigorosamente

nodes.source: no alcohol regime I have put myself on.
nodes.text: senza alcol che mi sono imposto.

nodes.source: Now I'm peckish, so will have a night cap (food) and retire for a nice long new year's sleep!!
nodes.text: Ora ho fame: ultimo boccone e un bel lungo sonno di Capodanno.

nodes.source: January 2005
nodes.text: Gennaio 2005

nodes.source: 1st January 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 1 gennaio 2005 - sabato

nodes.source: Good Morning and Merry New Year, 2005 is upon us and time waits for no one!
nodes.text: Buongiorno e buon anno! È arrivato il 2005 e il tempo non aspetta nessuno.

nodes.source: After managing to fall asleep sitting upright on the sofa last night, I managed to crawl to bed totally exhausted at about 05.30, still fell asleep with the lights on etc
nodes.text: Addormentato seduto sul divano, mi sono trascinato a letto esausto verso le 5:30. Dormito con le luci accese.

nodes.source: I still feel fine today, although possibly a little run down as my throat hurts like I've caught an infection, nothing major, it should be gone by tonight. My lungs coped extremely well with the smoky atmosphere last night, although I certainly noticed and felt it a lot more than usual, it'll be the last time I do a long stint out like that for a while.
nodes.text: Oggi ancora bene, forse un po’ giù, con mal di gola come un’infezione. Nulla di grave, dovrebbe passare stasera. I polmoni hanno retto bene il fumo, pur sentendolo molto più del solito. Ultima uscita così lunga per un po’.

nodes.source: Going to laze around all day today.
nodes.text: Oggi ozio tutto il giorno.

nodes.source: A  friend came over and I went shopping in Richmond, picked some hats out from Next in preparation for the hair loss side effect (so far it isn't happening) and browsed around a few sales. Back home now, got a mild headache but it's not stopping me doing anything, probably to do with the sleep depravation of last night.
nodes.text: È venuto un amico e sono andato a fare shopping a Richmond. Scelti cappelli da Next per la perdita dei capelli, non ancora iniziata, e guardati i saldi. Ora a casa, lieve mal di testa che non mi ferma, probabilmente per il poco sonno.

nodes.source: Cold and horrible outside so I'm not moving from home tonight.
nodes.text: Fuori freddo e brutto, stasera resto a casa.

nodes.source: Just watched the 'Manchurian Candidate' on DVD, is this all a conspiracy? Do I want it to be or shall I just be content that this is reality! Well perhaps the powers that be could turn me in to a super hero or something!
nodes.text: Visto The Manchurian Candidate in DVD. È tutta una cospirazione? Vorrei lo fosse o accetto la realtà? Magari i potenti potrebbero trasformarmi in un supereroe!

nodes.source: Hopefully a full nights sleep tonight.
nodes.text: Spero di dormire tutta la notte.

nodes.source: 2nd January 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 2 gennaio 2005 - domenica

nodes.source: All in all not a bad nights sleep and I'm not sure I had the usual sweats, I might have slept right through them and in them!! Still got this sore throat, more like swollen tonsils, awkward to swallow, but not that bad. I think it's a sign that my body is running lowered immune levels due to the chemotherapy I've had so far, a fact explained more clearly here, it's all about neutrophils!
nodes.text: Dormito abbastanza bene. Non so se ho sudato, forse ho dormito attraverso tutto! Gola ancora dolente, come tonsille gonfie che rendono difficile deglutire, ma non troppo. Credo siano difese basse per la chemio, spiegato meglio qui: è tutta questione di neutrofili!

nodes.source: Very lazy morning, just about to eat my breakfast at 1pm!!
nodes.text: Mattina pigrissima: colazione alle 13!

nodes.source: Late lunch and vegetated in front of the TV and internet all afternoon.
nodes.text: Pranzo tardi, pomeriggio a vegetare tra TV e internet.

nodes.source: Throat still the same tonight, although feels like it might be on its way out.
nodes.text: Gola uguale, ma sembra stia per migliorare.

nodes.source: Ordered Chinese tonight, good for me? I'll certainly enjoy it!!!
nodes.text: Ordinato cinese. Mi fa bene? Sicuramente me lo godrò!

nodes.source: 3rd January 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 3 gennaio 2005 - lunedì

nodes.source: I was very late to bed last night, old/bad habits starting to creep back in there. Scratch the sweating comments of previous, I definitely sweated last night and slept right through it, which I must admit I prefer, instead of waking up two or three times during the night!
nodes.text: Ancora a letto tardi: tornano le cattive abitudini. Dimenticate ciò che dicevo sui sudori, stanotte ho sudato dormendo senza svegliarmi. Meglio che svegliarsi due o tre volte.

nodes.source: It's 1pm again and I'm just about to have breakfast, as I have not long woken up. There's no one around looking out for me at the moment (aahhhh they sigh), so I guess I've slipped back in to my old routines.
nodes.text: Di nuovo le 13 e colazione, appena sveglio. Non c’è nessuno a badare a me ora, sospirate pure, così tornano le vecchie abitudini.

nodes.source: I must take on some more water today, I haven't been doing this as well as I had hoped to, whilst out of hospital.
nodes.text: Devo bere più acqua oggi. Fuori dall’ospedale non ci riesco come speravo.

nodes.source: My throat still feels uncomfortable when I swallow. People are starting to comment on my cough and how much noticeably better it has become, almost non existent!
nodes.text: Deglutire dà ancora fastidio. La gente nota la tosse molto migliorata, quasi inesistente!

nodes.source: Treatment day tomorrow, but this time I am not as anxious as before.
nodes.text: Domani terapia, stavolta meno ansia.

nodes.source: I've been pulling at my hair for days now with only the odd strand coming out, as normal as can be expected. Today marks the day when quite a few more are starting to come out, certainly a little more than normal, how long before I look like Captain John Luke Picard of the Enterprise?
nodes.text: Da giorni tiro i capelli e ne usciva qualcuno, normalmente. Oggi ne escono di più, oltre il solito. Quanto prima di sembrare il capitano Jean-Luc Picard dell’Enterprise?

nodes.source: Finally motivated myself to do the washing up (my Dishwasher broke a couple of days ago). Now I'm showered and off to see my Mum for a bit. I'll be looking forward to coming home for dinner later although I have absolutely no idea what to make myself.
nodes.text: Finalmente lavati i piatti, la lavastoviglie si è rotta due giorni fa. Doccia fatta, vado da mamma. Poi cena a casa, senza idea di cosa preparare.

nodes.source: Ok, I decided after a very late lunch indeed, I'm going to have a massive fruit and ice cream blow-out this evening and loads of water to follow. Got to get to bed as early as I can as I'm being picked up in the morning for hospital. Best for me not to drive as I may not be up to getting myself back home in the evening (I was rough last week).
nodes.text: Dopo pranzo tardissimo, deciso un’abbuffata di frutta e gelato con tanta acqua. Proverò a dormire presto, domani mi accompagnano in ospedale. Meglio non guidare: potrei non riuscire a tornare, la settimana scorsa stavo male.

nodes.source: Didn't get my early night after all, oh well I'll manage somehow, it's 2am now I'd better go get my head down. Night...
nodes.text: Niente letto presto: sono le due. Me la caverò. A dormire, notte...

nodes.source: 4th January 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 4 gennaio 2005 - martedì

nodes.source: Not a bad sleep, although short. Had breakfast and my tablets, now waiting for my lift to arrive for the hospital. Outpatient treatment day today, hopefully I will feel better than last Wednesday when I return home later. Throat still sore, will check with Docs today, I think I have a small ulcer at the back of my mouth (typical chemotherapy symptom).
nodes.text: Sonno breve ma buono. Colazione e compresse, aspetto il passaggio. Oggi terapia ambulatoriale, spero di tornare meglio di mercoledì scorso. Gola ancora dolente, chiederò ai medici. Credo a una piccola ulcera in fondo alla bocca, tipica della chemio.

nodes.source: Sitting here getting chemotherapy now.
nodes.text: Seduto qui a fare chemio.

nodes.source: Breaking news... Doc says my neutrophil levels are right down today (0.4 or 400!!) which is not good news at all, but to be expected whilst on chemotherapy, I now have to be really really careful of infection from the outside world, things you would normally breeze past like supermarkets, busy places, children are now all dangers to me. This also now means that I will have to undergo more needles in the form of 3 G-CSF injections over the next 3 days. My neutrophil levels were at 2.4 or 2400 last Wednesday when I arrived, still not brilliant but much better than today.
nodes.text: Ultim’ora: neutrofili bassissimi, 0,4 o 400! Brutta notizia, ma prevista con la chemio. Massima attenzione alle infezioni: supermercati, luoghi affollati e bambini, prima normali, ora sono pericoli. Servono tre iniezioni G-CSF in tre giorni. Mercoledì scorso erano 2,4 o 2400, non ideali ma molto meglio.

nodes.source: Well as you all can see I knew I was feeling run down in general as I kept complaining about my throat, I do have a small ulcer on my uvula (the dangly bit at the back of your mouth). Tonight might be a tough one for me, I'll be discharged (I think) but I'll be feeling rough if last week was anything to go by.
nodes.text: Sentivo già il calo lamentando la gola. Ho un’ulcera sull’ugola, quella che pende in fondo. Stasera potrebbe essere dura: credo mi dimettano, ma se è come la settimana scorsa starò male.

nodes.source: So far chemotherapy going well today. More breaking news... I've just received an update on my blood results/history and along with the slightly bad news above I have some good, my HCG tumour markers have now dropped from the original 3900 to 3300 to 805 and now 722!! Soon I will no longer be pregnant!! Despite this I am going to have to take some Antibiotics (Ciprofloxacin 250mg) over the next few days along with the G-CSF injections, to protect and fight any infection that may be lurking.
nodes.text: La chemio procede bene. Altre notizie: insieme alle brutte, buone. HCG scesa da 3900 a 3300, 805 e ora 722! Presto non sarò più incinto! Comunque prenderò ciprofloxacina da 250 mg per qualche giorno con G-CSF, contro possibili infezioni nascoste.

nodes.source: As Winston Churchill once said amidst one of his famous speeches...
nodes.text: Come disse Winston Churchill in un celebre discorso...

nodes.source: "whatever the cost may be, we shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds, we shall fight in the fields and in the streets, we shall fight in the hills; we shall never surrender"
nodes.text: «Qualunque sia il costo, combatteremo sulle spiagge, sui terreni di sbarco, nei campi e nelle strade, sulle colline; non ci arrenderemo mai».

nodes.source: and that's exactly my attitude, mentally and physically!
nodes.text: È esattamente il mio atteggiamento, fisico e mentale!

nodes.source: Home now and feeling better than I did last week, although my lungs feel a little heavy and I'm very, very slightly short of breath if I talk too much, nothing that is concerning me too much. Throat mildly better although it seems to dull in the evening, I now have some Difflan Oral Rinse to alleviate the symptoms if they get worse.
nodes.text: A casa, meglio della settimana scorsa. Polmoni un po’ pesanti e pochissimo fiato corto parlando troppo, nulla di preoccupante. Gola un po’ meglio, ma peggiora la sera. Ho il collutorio Difflan se serve.

nodes.source: I feel hungry too which is a good thing. A friend has come over to cook me a lovely dinner which I'm looking forward to. The night is young and my lack of sleep last night will serve as a good retirement time tonight.
nodes.text: Ho fame, buon segno. Un amico è venuto a preparare una bella cena che aspetto volentieri. La sera è giovane, ma il poco sonno di ieri mi farà ritirare presto.

nodes.source: Managed a little dinner and started my Antibiotics this evening.
nodes.text: Cenato un po’ e iniziati gli antibiotici.

nodes.source: Still feeling much the same although in need of the sleep so I've hit the sack at 23.30. Night all...
nodes.text: Sto uguale, ma serve sonno. A letto alle 23:30. Notte...

nodes.source: 5th January 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 5 gennaio 2005 - mercoledì

nodes.source: A nice long sleep, I woke early to say good-bye to my friend that stayed over, then went back in to a deep sleep until 11.30am. It's made me a little late for getting back to the hospital today, I should really be there 24 hours after the chemotherapy started yesterday for my G-CSF injection, well I hope to be there by 1pm. I feel fine today, the throat is still there and a little bit more of a cough is apparent. No more for now I must dash, Charing Cross, here I come!
nodes.text: Bel sonno lungo. Sveglio per salutare l’amico ospite, poi ancora sonno profondo fino alle 11:30. Sono in ritardo: G-CSF dovrebbe essere 24 ore dopo l’inizio della chemio. Spero di arrivare alle 13. Sto bene, gola ancora lì e più tosse. Scappo, Charing Cross!

nodes.source: G-CSF Injection went fine and I've spent ages with Milton chatting and helping him out with his Mac this afternoon.
nodes.text: Iniezione bene. Tanto tempo con Milton a chiacchierare e aiutarlo col Mac.

nodes.source: Still feeling fine and will be heading home soon to beat the rush hour.
nodes.text: Ancora bene, presto a casa prima del traffico.

nodes.source: The hair is really starting to come out now from everywhere! Instead of just a few strands I get a whole bunch if I pull at the hair on my head. Another little symptom I have noticed is that some of the ends of my fingers feel like they've been bruised, it's either a symptom or I've been typing too much on here to you lot!!!
nodes.text: I peli cadono ovunque. Tirando i capelli escono ciocche, non pochi fili. Alcuni polpastrelli sembrano lividi: effetto collaterale o troppo scrivere per voi!

nodes.source: Ate loads for dinner, still keeping up with the tablet schedule (Antibiotics (Ciprofloxacin) and Anti-sickness (Domperidome))
nodes.text: Cenato molto, continuo le compresse: antibiotico ciprofloxacina e domperidone contro la nausea.

nodes.source: Feeling good this evening, I even briefly popped out to a meeting that I would normally go to on a Wednesday night with the Masons and they've changed the smoking rules in the bar area so it was a nice clear atmosphere to have a chat in. They were very surprised to see me, I wanted them to see that I was looking good, feeling fine and doing well since they heard the shock news almost a month ago now (not many of them have internet access).
nodes.text: Bella serata. Breve visita alla solita riunione massonica del mercoledì. Cambiate le regole del fumo al bar, abbiamo parlato in aria pulita. Sorpresi di vedermi: volevo mostrare che ho bell’aspetto e sto bene dopo la notizia di quasi un mese fa. Molti non hanno internet.

nodes.source: Trying to get my head down early tonight as I would like to be on time for hospital tomorrow for my injection at 12pm. Then, all being well I'm going to take a drive out to my friends shop for a healthy lunch and to spend some time there.
nodes.text: Provo a dormire presto per arrivare all’iniezione delle 12. Poi, se tutto bene, guiderò al negozio degli amici per pranzo sano e compagnia.

nodes.source: 6th January 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 6 gennaio 2005 - giovedì

nodes.source: Slept well, although woke with a very mild headache (I stayed up a bit too late I think), it's fading away now as I eat my breakfast. Got to get ready for my 'day out' hospital first then Maidenhead. I'll be on the net so keeping you all up to date.
nodes.text: Dormito bene, lieve mal di testa per il letto tardi, già passa con la colazione. Mi preparo alla giornata: ospedale e Maidenhead. Resterò online per aggiornarvi.

nodes.source: Hospital visit was a breeze, injection went well, these ones are easy! Briefly caught up with Milton, he's doing fine but still isolated and confined to his room.
nodes.text: Ospedale facilissimo, queste iniezioni sono semplici. Visto brevemente Milton: bene, ma ancora isolato in stanza.

nodes.source: Got to Maidenhead a bit later than expected, the M4 motorway was closed due to a major accident and I got stuck in the subsequent jam!!
nodes.text: Arrivato tardi a Maidenhead: M4 chiusa per grave incidente e bloccato nel traffico!

nodes.source: Had a nice lunch from M&S and now chilling out in my friends shop in Maidenhead (I'm actually configuring their shiny new 20" iMac).
nodes.text: Bel pranzo M&S, ora relax nel negozio degli amici; in realtà configuro il nuovo iMac da 20 pollici.

nodes.source: OK a bit of a health update... symptoms I have had so far or currently suffering from...
nodes.text: Aggiornamento salute: sintomi avuti o attuali...

nodes.source: Hair loss
nodes.text: Perdita dei capelli

nodes.source: (ongoing and slow, recent)
nodes.text: (lenta e continua, recente)

nodes.source: Feeling of bruised finger tips
nodes.text: Polpastrelli come lividi

nodes.source: (very mild but ongoing, recent)
nodes.text: (molto lieve ma continuo, recente)

nodes.source: Sicky feeling in back of throat
nodes.text: Sensazione di nausea in fondo alla gola

nodes.source: (very very mild, early symptom)
nodes.text: (lievissima, sintomo iniziale)

nodes.source: Mouth Ulcers
nodes.text: Ulcere in bocca

nodes.source: (one, disappearing, recent)
nodes.text: (una, in via di guarigione, recente)

nodes.source: Sore Gums
nodes.text: Gengive dolenti

nodes.source: (very very mild, recent)
nodes.text: (lievissimo, recente)

nodes.source: Temperature and chills
nodes.text: Febbre e brividi

nodes.source: (occasionally)
nodes.text: (occasionalmente)

nodes.source: Constipation
nodes.text: Stitichezza

nodes.source: (major & very very painful to go!)
nodes.text: (forte e dolorosissimo evacuare!)

nodes.source: Cramps
nodes.text: Crampi

nodes.source: (one off so far, in feet & one leg)
nodes.text: (una volta finora, piedi e una gamba)

nodes.source: Sweating
nodes.text: Sudorazione

nodes.source: (ongoing during sleep)
nodes.text: (continua durante il sonno)

nodes.source: Cough
nodes.text: Tosse

nodes.source: (mild, occasionally)
nodes.text: (lieve, occasionale)

nodes.source: It's not all that bad, I can cope!
nodes.text: Non è così male, posso farcela!

nodes.source: Got in, had dinner, had a long hot salt bath (I'll leave it you to work out what I'm trying to heal, it's round the back!)
nodes.text: A casa, cena e lungo bagno caldo con sali. Indovinate cosa provo a curare: è sul retro!

nodes.source: Now sleep......
nodes.text: Ora a dormire...

nodes.source: 7th January 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 7 gennaio 2005 - venerdì

nodes.source: Slept very well although I stayed up a bit too late again last night (02.30), my hospital stay next week will get me back in to a good routine. Noticed the sweating a lot last night, it didn't wake me but seemed that when I did wake up, everything was a lot wetter and colder than normal (yuk!) and NO I didn't wet myself, that's not a symptom, thank you!!!
nodes.text: Dormito benissimo, ma ancora tardi, alle 2:30. Il ricovero della prossima settimana ripristinerà la routine. Sudato molto: non mi ha svegliato, ma al risveglio tutto era più bagnato e freddo. Bleah! E NO, non mi sono fatto la pipì addosso, non è un sintomo, grazie!

nodes.source: Getting ready for the last hospital injection today and then freedom for the weekend before Phase 2 of my major chemotherapy starts on Monday. There'll be lots to report next week!
nodes.text: Ultima iniezione oggi e fine settimana libero prima della seconda fase lunedì. Tanto da raccontare la prossima settimana!

nodes.source: Back from the hospital, injection went fine, nurse was in a little bit of a hurry today so I felt it a little more than normal but it went just fine for me. Both my sisters with me today and one of them didn't feel too well at the thought of my injection, so I had to sit her down after she nearly blacked out!
nodes.text: A casa. L’infermiera aveva fretta e l’ho sentita un po’ più, ma bene. Con me le due sorelle; una quasi sveniva pensando all’iniezione e l’ho dovuta far sedere.

nodes.source: Bumped in to my Dr. today, he had some news for me. My HCG tumour marker levels as of Tuesday the 4th Jan 2005 are now down to just 75!! He commented that this is a very impressive result considering we are only at the early stages of my treatment. I do not know my current neutrophil levels but these should be back up to normal very soon as my current course of G-CSF injections have now finished.
nodes.text: Incontrato il medico: HCG di martedì 4 a 75! Dice che è notevole per l’inizio delle cure. Non so i neutrofili attuali, ma dovrebbero normalizzarsi presto dopo le iniezioni G-CSF.

nodes.source: Is this a sign of positive thinking plus the right course of medication? I think so! Lets keep our fingers crossed that I can maintain my 'impressive' battle levels!
nodes.text: Pensiero positivo più farmaci giusti? Credo di sì! Incrociamo le dita per mantenere questo livello di battaglia «notevole».

nodes.source: Feeling quite tired tonight but I must cook myself some dinner otherwise I'll be feeling even worse in the morning. Getting someone to do my shopping for me is quite embarrassing as I certainly feel like I should be doing it myself, only thing is the less exposure to the general public in the outside world the better (increased risk of infection being the only reason). So a good friend is coming over in the morning to collect my shopping list and pay a much needed visit to Sainsbury's.
